children: Overview
China property developer's H1 revenue fell 20% yr/yr amid weak market demand
Net loss attributable to shareholders widened to RMB8.83 bln for the period
Company cites challenging market, lower sales and liquidity pressures; material uncertainties over going concern
Outlook
Agile Group expects continued policy support but sees market confidence and recovery as uncertain
Company plans to accelerate property pre-sales and deliveries, focusing on Pearl and Yangtze River Delta clusters
Agile Group aims to reach agreement with major overseas creditors and expedite debt restructuring in H2 2026
Result Drivers
SALES DECLINE - Co said aggregate pre-sold value of property projects fell 26.5% yr/yr, with GFA pre-sold down 26.1% yr/yr, impacting liquidity
MARKET VOLATILITY - Co cited ongoing deep adjustment and volatility in China's real estate sector, with recovery of market confidence below expectations
COST CONTAINMENT - Co said it is actively controlling administrative costs and capital expenditures, including salary reductions, to improve liquidity
